_transcription: ENGLISH half only, CBSE Class 10 Science (086), Series Z1XYW/4 SET-3, Q.P. Code 31/4/3. 24 page images: idx 0 cover, idx 1 Hindi instructions, idx 2 English instructions + Q1-4; English on EVERY EVEN index 2-22, Hindi on every odd index 3-21 (each the Hindi of the page after it; idx 21 read at full size, all Hindi); idx 23 (folio 24) is BLANK, the cover announces 23 printed pages. Questions run 1-39 unbroken. Printed instructions confirm sci80: 39 questions, A Q1-20 MCQ x1 (17-20 Assertion-Reason), B 21-26 x2, C 27-33 x3, D 34-36 x5, E 37-39 x4. Instruction (viii) prints NO count of internal choices, so the roster was built by walking the marking scheme (ms idx 2-9, footer X_086_31/4/3 on every page, a per-set scheme) for a bare OR: Q22, 26, 30, 31, 33, 36, 37(iii), 38(iii), 39(iii) = 9 alternatives, each confirmed against a printed OR on the paper; Q21, 23, 24, 25, 27, 28, 29, 32, 34, 35 carry none. All 20 Section-A keys are CBSE's own, read off ms idx 2, each re-derived: all agree, Q15 flagged (its stem asks for the direction of MOTION, the key is the direction of FORCE) and Q16 carries the same arguable-wording flag as its 31/4/1 twin. No void, grace or either-of-two note anywhere in the scheme. Sibling of 31/4/1: questions shared with it were confirmed on this paper's own pages and their stem, context, options, answer, chapter, subtopic and difficulty copied byte for byte; every _figure was read on this paper's pages. Decimal points on this paper are ordinary full stops (Q14: 0.06A; Q38: 2.42, 1.5, 2.25).
